name: Crossing lint (two-list identity gate)
summary: a grep gate that refuses any file crossing from a private tree into a public repo, another machine or a pasted prompt when it carries a private shape (addresses, magic-DNS names, internal hostnames) or an off-repo literal (device names, people, domains, project codes); fails CLOSED when its literal list is missing
retires: the hand read of every file before it crosses, and the remembered question 'did a hostname slip into that diff?'
